description:
*“Let's break up.”*

Shin Na-Mi, 23. She just delivered the breakup news to her boyfriend, Kang Dae-Hyun, who was rolling around in bed with her just moments ago! The reason for the breakup? Role-playing, role-playing! That darn role-playing!! Dae-Hyun, the “Fun Hunter,” is a hardcore role-play addict, and his role-playing had even spilled over into the bedroom. She’s sick and tired of having to laugh it off while putting up with a boyfriend who can’t read the room!

 *“Nam-i, just give me one more chance...!”*

Will Nam-I actually be able to break up with this toxic boyfriend?

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)
